ios.desc:
Your all-in-one AI shopping assistant for finding products, tracking prices, and unlocking savings.

Get real-time prices from every major retailer in seconds:

• Instantly compare live prices across major retailers — all in one search.
• Skip endless tabs and manual searching — get real-time retailer comparisons in seconds.
• Shop only from authorized retailers, so every result is warranty-covered.
• Get rewarded for shopping early instead of waiting for prices to drop.

Point your camera or drop in an image — Silicon Iris finds where to buy:

• See it. Search it. Shop it. Find trending items with one quick camera scan.
• From inspiration to checkout in seconds with seamless image-to-shopping search.
• Pull from your camera roll for products you saved earlier.
• Built for modern shoppers who discover products through images, creators, and social trends.

7-Day Price Match Refund Promise:

• Found a lower price after checkout? We'll match it and refund the savings.
• Receive price alerts the moment an item prices drop.
• Buy today stress-free knowing you're protected against lower prices after purchase.
• Your own personal AI shopping assistant monitors prices so you can shop worry-free and never overpay.

Get Personalized Discount Codes, Built In:

• Shop smarter by catching real-time deal drops and countdown offers that keep prices moving lower.
• Fair pricing, trusted shopping, and automatic refund protection in one experience.
• Get a deeper discount the moment you buy with friends through Group Buy.
• Codes refresh continuously, so "this code has expired" never appears at checkout.

Share an item with friends and unlock a deeper discount the more people join:

• Team up with friends to unlock unbeatable group-buy prices on thousands of products every day.
• Save more when more people join — the bigger the group, the lower the price.
• Enjoy a fun social shopping experience with easy sharing, rewards, and daily savings opportunities.
• Get incredible value on everyday essentials without sacrificing quality.

Shop privately and securely:

• Sign in once with Apple — no email, no password to remember.
• We don't sell your data to advertisers.
• We don't track you across other apps.
• Your shopping conversations stay yours.


Learn more about Silicon: https://siliconstore.com
Privacy policy: https://siliconstore.com/privacy-policy
Terms of service: https://siliconstore.com/terms
Support: support@siliconstore.com
